fields.label: Your S S N or I T I N (9 digits).
fields.pdfWidgetName: Your S S N or I T I N (9 digits)

fields.label: Part I, Line 1. 2025 tax after credits from Form 540, line 48, line 61, line 62, and any I R C Section 453A interest from line 63; Form 540NR, line 63, line 71, line 72, and any I R C Section 453A interest from line 73; or Form 541, line 28.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Part I, Line 1. 2025 tax after credits from Form 540, line 48, line 61, line 62, and any I R C Section 453A interest from line 63; Form 540NR, line 63, line 71, line 72, and any I R C Section 453A interest from line 73; or Form 541, line 28

fields.label: Line 2. 2025 tax on lump-sum distributions and accumulation distribution of trusts from Form 540, line 34; Form 540NR, line 41; or Form 541, line 21b.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 2. 2025 tax on lump-sum distributions and accumulation distribution of trusts from Form 540, line 34; Form 540NR, line 41; or Form 541, line 21b

fields.label: Line 3. Subtract line 2 from line 1.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 3. Subtract line 2 from line 1

fields.label: Line 4. Multiply line 3 by 66 and two-thirds % (.6667).
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 4. Multiply line 3 by 66 and two-thirds % (.6667)

fields.label: Line 5. 2025 withholding taxes from Form 540, line 71 and line 73; Form 540NR, line 81 and line 83; or Form 541, line 29 and line 31.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 5. 2025 withholding taxes from Form 540, line 71 and line 73; Form 540NR, line 81 and line 83; or Form 541, line 29 and line 31

fields.label: Line 6. Subtract line 5 from line 3. If less than $500 ($250 if married/R D P filing separately), STOP. You do not owe a penalty.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 6. Subtract line 5 from line 3. If less than $500 ($250 if married/R D P filing separately), STOP. You do not owe a penalty

fields.label: Line 7. 2024 tax after credits from Form 540, line 48, line 61, line 62, and any I R C Section 453A interest from line 63; Form 540NR, line 63, line 71, line 72, and any I R C Section 453A interest from line 73; or Form 541, line 28. (If you did not file a return for 2024 or if your 2024 taxable year was less than 12 months, do not complete line 7 through line 9. Instead, enter the amount from line 4 on line 10.)
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 7. 2024 tax after credits from Form 540, line 48, line 61, line 62, and any I R C Section 453A interest from line 63; Form 540NR, line 63, line 71, line 72, and any I R C Section 453A interest from line 73; or Form 541, line 28. (If you did not file a return for 2024 or if your 2024 taxable year was less than 12 months, do not complete line 7 through line 9. Instead, enter the amount from line 4 on line 10.)

fields.label: Line 8. 2024 tax on lump-sum distributions and accumulation distribution of trusts from Form 540, line 34; Form 540NR, line 41; or Form 541, line 21b.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 8. 2024 tax on lump-sum distributions and accumulation distribution of trusts from Form 540, line 34; Form 540NR, line 41; or Form 541, line 21b

fields.label: Line 9. Subtract line 8 from line 7. If less than $500 ($250 if married/R D P filing separately), STOP. You do not owe a penalty.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 9. Subtract line 8 from line 7. If less than $500 ($250 if married/R D P filing separately), STOP. You do not owe a penalty

fields.label: Line 10. Enter the smaller of line 4 or line 9. (If your California A G I is equal to or greater than $1,000,000/$500,000 for married filing a separate return, use line 4.).
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 10. Enter the smaller of line 4 or line 9. (If your California A G I is equal to or greater than $1,000,000/$500,000 for married filing a separate return, use line 4.)

fields.label: Line 11. 2025 withholding taxes and estimated tax payments made on or before January 15, 2026, from Form 540, line 71, line 72, and line 73; Form 540NR, line 81, line 82, and line 83; or Form 541, line 29, line 31, and line 32.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 11. 2025 withholding taxes and estimated tax payments made on or before January 15, 2026, from Form 540, line 71, line 72, and line 73; Form 540NR, line 81, line 82, and line 83; or Form 541, line 29, line 31, and line 32

fields.label: Line 12. Underpayment. Subtract line 11 from line 10. If zero or less, you do not owe a penalty. Be sure to check the box on Form 540, line 113; Form 540NR, line 123; or Form 541, line 45.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 12. Underpayment. Subtract line 11 from line 10. If zero or less, you do not owe a penalty. Be sure to check the box on Form 540, line 113; Form 540NR, line 123; or Form 541, line 45

fields.label: Part II, Line 13. Enter the date (mm/dd/yyyy) the amount on line 12 was paid or April 15, 2026, whichever is earlier.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Part II, Line 13. Enter the date (mm/dd/yyyy) the amount on line 12 was paid or April 15, 2026, whichever is earlier

fields.label: Line 14. Number of days after January 15, 2026, to and including the date on line 13.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 14. Number of days after January 15, 2026, to and including the date on line 13

fields.label: Line 15. Penalty: Number of days on line 14 divided by 365 multiplied by 0.7 multiplied by underpayment on line 12. Enter the result here. If you are requesting a waiver, go to line 16. Otherwise, enter this amount on Form 540, line 113; Form 540NR, line 123; or Form 541, line 45. Also, check the box on that line to show that form F T B 5805F is attached to the return.
